Verify

Check your download.

How to verify a download

01SHA-256

All 64 characters must match the ones listed under its version.

Linuxsha256sum veylor_0.9.1_amd64.deb
Macshasum -a 256 veylor-1.0.3-10.apk
WindowsGet-FileHash .\veylor-1.0.3-10.apk

02Build record

GitHub signs a record of each build from Veylor's public code. Check it with GitHub's CLI; the second command prints the commit it was built from.

Verifygh attestation verify veylor_0.9.1_amd64.deb --repo ChinmayGopal931/vizor-fork --signer-workflow ChinmayGopal931/vizor-fork/.github/workflows/veylor-linux.yml
Commitgh attestation verify veylor_0.9.1_amd64.deb --repo ChinmayGopal931/vizor-fork --signer-workflow ChinmayGopal931/vizor-fork/.github/workflows/veylor-linux.yml --format json --jq '.[].verificationResult.signature.certificate.sourceRepositoryDigest'

03APK certificate

It must be Veylor's, below. Google Play's copy is signed by Google, so the two don't update each other.

apksigner verify --print-certs veylor-1.0.3-10.apk
SHA-25683f16e2037b09e731e51b3472466db43c4a962ada1fb4e40eaa4c3215a2174f5

04APK and its build

The APK is the attested build plus Veylor's signature. Check the build, then that the signature is the only difference.

Buildgh attestation verify veylor-1.0.3-10-unsigned.apk --repo ChinmayGopal931/vizor-fork --signer-workflow ChinmayGopal931/vizor-fork/.github/workflows/veylor-android.yml --format json --jq '.[].verificationResult.signature.certificate.sourceRepositoryDigest'
Compareapksigcopier compare veylor-1.0.3-10.apk --unsigned veylor-1.0.3-10-unsigned.apk

iPhone apps are encrypted and re-signed by Apple, so they can't be compared with their source.
